name: invader
character: Space Invader, crab (Space Invaders' medium invader, 2nd and 3rd rows)
facing: none (the invaders are symmetric; the formation marches right, then steps down and marches left)
colors: harness-tags colorMode 0 (Game's own), color packs enabled; pixels are the emulator's output, nothing repainted
scene: ORIGINAL 2D mode, first wave, all 55 invaders alive, first sweep to the right (menu: RIGHT at frame 510 selects ORIGINAL 2D)
frames: 1106-1215 (one full cycle; frames 1030-1340 checked, every trusted frame of a cel is pixel-identical)

canvas.alignment: exactly the invader's own 8-row tile area; both cels share the same columns, so they play in place

speed_note: the invader moves 2 px every time its cel changes; with all 55 alive that is every 55 frames (it speeds up as invaders die)
palette_note: distinct opaque RGB colors across all cels of this character; every pixel is fully opaque or fully transparent
